memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression: ongoing, PHQ-9 12, on sertraline 50 mg OD. Plan: continue sertraline, add psychotherapy referral.
- Coronary artery disease: stable, on aspirin 75 mg OD, atorvastatin 40 mg HS, metoprolol 25 mg OD, isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD, GTN SOS. Plan: continue, treadmill test scheduled.
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux: mild heartburn, on pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, antacid gel SOS, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals. Plan: continue.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut-off 80 cm, elevated). Advised reduced carbohydrate intake, small frequent meals.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.
